name: @orillusion/physics-rapier
author: Orillusion
description: Orillusion Physics Plugin, Powered by Rapier (Rust → WASM).

scripts.build: vite build && npm run build:types && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:clean: mv dist/packages/physics-rapier/* dist && rm -rf dist/src && rm -rf dist/packages
scripts.docs:typedoc: npx typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --tsconfig tsconfig.json --gitRevision main --hideBreadcrumbs --router member --readme none --excludeInternal --excludePrivate --excludeProtected --excludeExternals --sort source-order --out
